limitations: Admission extends only to the disposable actual-eight qualification. The reviewed objective implements clean CE plus KL(stopgrad(clean), perturbed) with alpha 1. It masks and normalizes each example’s direction over valid h entries, probes at 0.001 times the valid-h norm, detaches the resulting direction, and applies it at 0.01 times that norm. Roles pass through unchanged and padding receives zero perturbation.

The probe uses autograd.grad with respect to the probe alone. It leaves parameter .grad fields untouched and preserves the clean CE graph for the final backward. The supplied CPU report gives a maximum parameter-gradient error of 4.84e-11 against NumPy with the target and perturbation held fixed. That check covers the intended final gradient. It takes the computed perturbation as input, so it does not independently verify the power-step direction. The separate alpha-zero test compares loss, every parameter gradient, generator state, and the clipped AdamW update against the pinned dense CE function for all four wrappers.

QVAT and Qrandom request the same native quantum initialization. Each model owns a seed-13 generator and draws once per enabled update. Qrandom uses the initial masked unit direction directly with the same radius and KL weight. Separate generators remove the cross-lane RNG race. Exact paired draws on GPU depend on matching batch shapes, draw order, and compatible CUDA RNG execution across devices. The supplied CPU tests do not exercise that cross-device pairing. Direct callers of objective can also pass generator=None and reach the global RNG, although the campaign callback supplies a private generator.

The Q and D wrappers delegate their forward calls to the native heads. Gaussian VAT selects gaussian_base from the supplied Gaussian reference identified by the 6174cb5a hash prefix. The CPU report records 81,028 parameters for every arm. The three VAT arms incur an extra probe forward and input-gradient calculation relative to Qrandom.

The disabled resolver returns the baseline callable itself. Enabled training records objective history and cumulative CE and KL components, while assessment retains clean-logit CE. The diff introduces an unconditional import of consistency but shows no edits to fit ordering, checkpointing, scheduling, or budget boundaries. Those surrounding paths were available only as diff context. The declared dense path uses batch 128 with the historical microbatch field inactive. The 600-second allowance includes fit and assessment for each arm.

The design specifies four 1,024-update fits with seed 13, the original AdamW settings, 8,192 fit examples, and 4,096 assessment examples. The summary computes all-40 macro F1 and uses strict greater-than for all seven comparisons. Before campaign reporting, the runtime must supply cfg['reused_native_rows'] from the pinned report. The supplied design names the report but omits that mapping, and summarize checks its length, order hash, support, and update counts without checking the four comparator identities. This dependency is downstream of actual-eight qualification.

This review used the supplied source, diff, and synthetic report. Actual-eight gradients and updates, GPU execution, runtime budget, and task utility remain unverified. The frozen stop rule permits no sweep or comparator substitution. Even seven wins would authorize full-protocol design only. L3 and L4-T remain unaccepted.
